name: Punk Graphics
visualIdentity: Supplemental reference, not a named source style. Cutout lettering, torn paper, tape, photocopy grain, and handwritten marks sit in a deliberately irregular layout. The headline stays prominent, and materials keep distinct edges and textures.
suitableUses: Explicitly suited to posters, title cards, and short protest-style edits where the cutout chaos is the message. Inferred: interactive hero or gallery use, since hybrid guidance describes it. Corporate or accessibility-critical use is unspecified.
limitations: The headline must stay prominent and the palette limited. Two-color contrast checks do not verify text over textures, photos, or animation, so composited frames must be rechecked. Accent red is decorative only at 4.26 contrast, so body text belongs on the background.
palette: Suggested tokens, used only when no task or brand palette is supplied: background #EFE9D9 for paper layout, foreground #171717 for ink text, and accent_1 #C63A3A as decorative protest red. Foreground on background contrast is 14.793. Gradients are disabled, and supplied colors override these.
motionAndInteraction: Explicit motion is pasting, peeling, and tearing with small placement imperfections. Hybrid guidance keeps paste and tear moves abrupt rather than springy. Optional references motion-012, motion-015, and motion-020 apply only when a scene supports their action. Interactive use may tie progress to scroll.
audio: Audio is unspecified by the style and not mandatory. Direction should be topic-driven, suggesting music, voiceover, effects, or silence after considering topic and audience. Speech must stay intelligible and never compete with narration. Explicit user audio choices take precedence.
assetRequirements: Cutout lettering and torn masks are preprocessed with Pillow using fixed seeds. Photos are halftoned in #171717 on #EFE9D9 with one fixed dot angle and size. Fonts and assets must load before rendering. Rough.js is optional for sketch marks only. Source artwork and font names are unspecified.
combinations: Use alone for posters, title cards, and chaos-as-message edits. Hybrid with style-093 adds timed slogan paste, tear, and peel moves. Hybrid with style-050 applies one monochrome halftone to pasted photos. Choose hybrids only when slogans need timing or photos need one print treatment.
productionApproach: HyperFrames is the default for composition, timing, validation, and export. Remotion is a fallback only when HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation applies, and the reason must be recorded. Pillow and the style renderer build visuals, and GSAP owns motion. Check key frames and the full decoded video before delivery.
